verdict.rationale: Reflect documents an official REST API with OAuth 2 and PKCE, and links to an OpenAPI 3.0 spec on openpm, so developers can build their own clients against it. However, no official SDK or client library is documented. The API surface is also narrow: graphs, links, appending to daily notes, creating notes and the user profile, and note contents cannot be read because of end-to-end encryption. Missing for 10: any official language SDKs or client libraries, read access to note contents, versioning and deprecation policy, sandbox or test environment, independent or hands-on corroboration of building against the API.
